name: 張彥元
objective:
課程重點：(1) 藉由適合其程度的教材加強學生必備的基礎文法觀念和句型結構；(2) 使學生確切把握閱讀要領以及充分瞭解寫作的各種技巧，重心在生字、片語、句法的解釋和基本寫作技巧的分析；(3) 熟悉英語人士日常生活情境及與學生將來就業環境相關之會話及適當之應對方式；(4) 透過練習加強聽、說、讀、寫的知能及表達。
This course is designed (1) to strengthen students' previously required knowledge in English with basic grammatical ideas and sentence patterns reviewed through reading materials appropriate to their levels; (2) to develop reading skill by giving explanation of difficult words, phrases, and syntax, as well as analysis of basic writing skill; (3) to  familiarize students with useful expressions in conversation and build up their confidence in cross-cultural communication; (4) to reinforce the competence and performance of listening, speaking, reading and writing by practice.

materials:
All Things Tech 1; 東華
ISBN：9786267130889・作者：Joseph Schier
本課程為專業英文（ESP / EAP）課程，教材、講義及簡報均為全英文；課堂授課及師生互動之英語使用比例 70%(含) 以上
consultation: 請利用 Line 班群聯繫老師
延伸教學與資源: ● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching) 強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration) 運用生成式 AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS 等新興科技輔助教學與評量。Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.● 數位教材資源應用 (Application of Digital Resources) 採用影音多媒體或具開放授權之資源（如 OCW、開放教科書）作為主要或輔助教材。Adopts multimedia or open-licensed resources (e.g., OCW, Open Textbooks) as primary or supplementary teaching materials.
課程是否導入AI: ● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）● 使用生成式 AI 進行課堂即時互動（Use generative AI for real-time classroom interaction）
